ranked.headline: Genomic and protein foundation models probed for mechanistic and geometric fidelity
ranked.summary: Benchmarks now test whether genomic and protein models encode regulatory logic and evolutionary structure, not just task accuracy.

ranked.headline: Drug and immunotherapy response models show limited transfer beyond training cohorts
ranked.summary: Uncertainty estimates and cross-cohort tests now probe whether drug response predictors hold beyond their training distributions.

ranked.headline: Statistical methods map cell states and cell-cell influence in spatial transcriptomics
ranked.summary: Spatial and single-cell datasets now support explicit probabilistic models of cell location, gene expression, and regulatory state within one framework.

ranked.headline: Tools convert sequencing reads into pathogen, taxonomic, and abundance calls
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers benchmark end-to-end microbial sequencing pipelines, exposing performance gaps in assembly, classification, and QC.

ranked.headline: Grounding LLM agents in biological evidence for annotation, retrieval, and drug tasks
ranked.summary: Recent preprints couple structured evidence, such as DE genes and knowledge graphs, with multi-step LLM reasoning for biological tasks.

ranked.headline: Graph and sequence deep learning predicts molecular interactions and gene regulation
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs transformers and graph networks with sequence, structure, and single-cell data to predict interactions, functions, and regulatory links.

ranked.headline: Software tools for somatic variant, methylation, cfDNA and CRISPR dependency analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers describe open pipelines for read-level methylation, germline filtering and confounder-aware mutant allele analysis.

ranked.headline: Computational tools link spatial transcriptomics, histology and single-cell profiles
ranked.summary: Foundation models and benchmarks now connect spatial transcriptomics, histology and scRNA-seq quality control into shared analytic workflows.

ranked.headline: MSA perturbation and residue-distance tools probe alternative protein states
ranked.summary: Preprint and published tools now pair AlphaFold3 ensemble sampling with residue-level interaction analysis to map protein conformational range.

ranked.headline: Genetic background and sequencing choice shape variant calling and effect inference
ranked.summary: Expanding diverse genome datasets and saturation assays are exposing how reference composition and genetic background alter variant-level conclusions.

ranked.headline: Biological representation learning tested under missing data and low supervision
ranked.summary: Recent studies test whether biological representations hold up under missing modalities, covariate shift, and scarce labels.

ranked.headline: Context and distribution shift govern when learned molecular predictors generalize
ranked.summary: Four April 2026 preprints probe when learned predictors transfer across shifted labels, targets and tasks, though their results remain provisional.

ranked.headline: General LLMs and DNA language models evaluated on raw genome sequence understanding
ranked.summary: Recent preprints supply benchmarks to test whether general and genomic language models extract biological information from raw nucleotide sequences.

ranked.headline: Coupling Parameters Set Oscillatory Regimes in Spiking, Mass and CPG Models
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published laminar model map how synaptic, delay, plasticity, and neuromodulatory parameters shape rhythmic dynamics.

ranked.headline: LLM agents automate multi-step computational biology workflows across omics and modeling
ranked.summary: Recent preprints show LLM agents coordinating end-to-end analysis, calibration, and uncertainty quantification across omics and systems models.

ranked.headline: Reproducible environment resolution and genomic visualization in bioinformatics software
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers extend reproducibility into environment resolution, library design and genome visualization software.

ranked.headline: Machine learning and mediation models are being extended to high-dimensional genomic data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published toolkit address scalability, zero-inflation and interpretability in high-dimensional genomic inference.

ranked.headline: Harmonizing heterogeneous omics tool outputs into queryable, interoperable resources
ranked.summary: Splicing, RNA-seq, somatic variant and vesicle data are now being packaged into harmonized formats and recombinable annotation layers.

ranked.headline: Genomic context and regulatory elements inform expression and gene discovery
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published atlas quantify how chromosomal position and noncoding elements shape expression and gene identification.

ranked.headline: Learned scoring and benchmarking of molecular interactions and reaction networks
ranked.summary: Graph-based interaction scoring now faces systematic benchmarking against large experimental pKa and structural reference datasets.

ranked.headline: Repeat-robust k-mer estimators quantify mutation rates between related sequences
ranked.summary: New repeat-robust k-mer estimators for mutation rates were tested on alpha satellite repeats and released as open-source software.

ranked.headline: Graph attention fuses ligand graphs and protein contact maps for binding prediction
ranked.summary: Sequence-based and structure-aware graph attention models now target affinity prediction, protein-molecule docking, and acetylcholinesterase screening.

ranked.headline: ODE and spin-glass models probe bistability and phase structure in disease dynamics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply ODE and Hamiltonian models to bistability and thresholds, alongside a published seven-layer aged brain multi-omics integration.

ranked.headline: Latent diffusion models extend to histology staining and drug-response prediction
ranked.summary: Latent diffusion models are now conditioned on tissue structure and compound context for virtual staining and transcriptional prediction.

ranked.headline: Mechanistic models couple local processes to resolved cellular and tissue outcomes
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published model extend mechanistic frameworks to single-cell integration, tumor invasion, and phagocytic engulfment dynamics.

ranked.headline: Diffusion models generate molecular structures guided by pretraining, MD, and pockets
ranked.summary: Recent diffusion work adds conformer pretraining, MD-trained temporal consistency, and flexible protein pocket modeling to molecular structure generation.

ranked.headline: Joint multiomic profiling links regulatory programs to chromatin and cell states
ranked.summary: Joint measurement of chromatin, expression, and copy number now links regulatory networks to development, aging, and disease.

ranked.headline: Computational modeling guides GPCR structure determination and ligand-site mapping
ranked.summary: Computation now sets experimental constructs for GPCR cryo-EM, while MD and mapping resolve receptor subtype and ligand plasticity.

ranked.headline: Generative models steered by explicit objectives for proteins, peptides and molecules
ranked.summary: Multiobjective and target-specific design requires explicit, controllable specification of objectives rather than unconditional sampling from generative models.

ranked.headline: Self-supervised and training-free models for neural and brain imaging data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply self-supervised pretraining and training-free inference to calcium, brain mesh, and fMRI data beyond sequence-based models.

ranked.headline: Structural and genomic-context methods are annotating archaeal and bacterial proteomes
ranked.summary: Fold-level classification of archaeal proteomes and k-mer genetic code inference extend annotation beyond direct sequence comparison.

ranked.headline: Simulations map LPS-phospholipid interfaces that bind antimicrobial peptides
ranked.summary: Coarse-grained MD of E. coli outer membrane models now resolves peptide and polymer partitioning at LPS-phospholipid interfaces.

ranked.headline: Analytical choices shape accuracy in MS-based strain, variant and quantity inference
ranked.summary: Proteomics workflows now embed variant handling, de novo strain calling and quantification choices, each evaluated for its effect on accuracy.

ranked.headline: Protein dynamics software: HX-MS data handling, CEST fitting, flexibility, MD compression
ranked.summary: Dynamics data from HX-MS, CEST NMR, structures, and MD trajectories each need dedicated standardized handling, analysis, prediction, and storage tools.

ranked.headline: Structure-guided de novo design converges on integrated computational ligand workflows
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a publication package de novo generation, free energy estimation, and fragment prescreening into unified computational tools.

ranked.headline: Sequence-level methods sharpen immunoglobulin annotation and V(D)J repertoire analysis
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs long-read V(D)J transcript analysis with curated germline IG and TCR annotation and reference-bias reduction.

ranked.headline: Deep learning decodes cell-type enhancer and motif syntax across mammals and development
ranked.summary: Single-cell chromatin and transcriptome atlases now pair with deep learning to predict enhancer activity and variant effects across mammals and humans.

ranked.headline: Graph and hypergraph models are recovering cell structure from single-cell data
ranked.summary: Hypergraph and multi-omics graph formulations are being tested against established and deep-learning baselines for single-cell profile partitioning.
